name: TransitionLooper
description: DJ transition looper for NTS-3. Always records AUDIO IN into a tempo-synced 16-step stereo ring (plus wrap glue). On pad-down, the nearest 16th clock becomes relative step 1 and the previous bar freezes as the loop. Firmware 1.4+ pre-rolls via get_raw_input while the pad is up; otherwise the first hold records one live bar. Untouched = bypass. Hold to fade into the loop; release to fade back. X = fade time, Y = filter sweep / STEP edge sharpness, Depth = wet. TYPE: VOL, HPF, LPF, BASS, ECHO, BRK, ROLL, STEP. STEP picks loop vs live per relative step; PAT selects ALT / INV / H8 / L8 / Q4.

params.name: TIME
params.detail: Fade in/out length, tempo-synced from a 1/32 note to 2 bars

params.name: TONE
params.detail: Filter/bass-swap sweep range; in STEP mode, loop/live edge sharpness

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Loop wet level while the pad is held

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: Transition: VOL, HPF, LPF, BASS, ECHO, BRK, ROLL, STEP

params.name: PAT
params.detail: STEP mask: ALT (odd loop), INV, H8 (1-8 loop), L8 (9-16 loop), Q4 (alternating quarters)
